claims.claim: Each Bagrut subject grade is 70% external exam + 30% magen (a 2026 wartime option allows 60% exam / 40% magen when it raises the grade). The Psychometric test weights Quantitative 40%, Verbal 40%, English 20% through autumn 2026; from December 2026 it becomes Quantitative 50% + Verbal 50% with the verbal writing task about 20%. Universities typically weight the sekhem about 40% Bagrut and 60% Psychometric (varies by program). The PET standard deviation is about 100, with roughly 68% of test-takers scoring between 430 and 630.
claims.raw_snippet: במקצועות שבהם משקל הבחינה הוא 70% והמגן 30%, היחס ישתנה ל-60% בחינה ו-40% מגן במידה והדבר יעלה את הציון הסופי

claims.claim: From the December 2026 (winter תשפ"ז) session, English is removed from the psychometric test and assessed separately via NITE's computerized English test (AMIRNET, part of the AMIR family); the general score becomes Quantitative 50% + Verbal 50%. Scale stays 200-800; older three-domain scores remain valid 7 years.
claims.raw_snippet: החל ממועד חורף (דצמבר) 2026 יופרד תחום האנגלית מהבחינה הפסיכומטרית ... https://www.nite.org.il/two-domain-psychometric-test/general-information/?lang=en

claims.claim: The Psychometric Entrance Test registration fee is about 665 NIS / 665 ש"ח as of 2026 (confirm on the NITE price page).

The Bagrut passing grade is 55; a grade of 45-54 is failing. A full certificate requires at least 21 study units. Universities award flat per-subject 5-unit bonuses only when the subject grade is at least 60 (Technion: math +30, sciences +25, humanities/English +20; Tel Aviv University: math +35).
claims.raw_snippet: הטכניון מעניק את מקדם ההטבה לציון 60 ומעלה

claims.claim: New immigrants receive a Hebrew-level bonus on Bagrut exams: +10 points at basic level (alef) or +15 points at levels bet/gimel, for 10 years from aliyah or until age 23 (whichever is later); Ethiopian immigrants get 12 years.
claims.raw_snippet: ברמה א' תינתן תוספת של 10 נקודות, וברמות ב' ו-ג' תינתן תוספת של 15 נקודות ... 10 שנים או עד גיל 23

claims.claim: PET scale is 200-800, mean about 530, section scores 50-150, valid 7 years. Offered in Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, French, Spanish, and combined.

Bagrut retakes (moed bet, grade improvement), school-grade appeals, learning-disability accommodations, and reserve-duty accommodations are administered per Ministry of Education rules and summarized on Kol Zchut.
